msg: You will see gnomes divided into two groups - hat size (big and small) and color (brown vs purples, yellow vs red, blue vs orange, and pink vs green).  First, try picking a gnome with a small hat.  If both gnomes on screen have small hats, try one color or the other.  For example, lets save you have a yellow and red gnome, both with small hats.  Try the yellow gnome.  If that gnome leads you to 20+ mushrooms, keep choosing that same exact gnome whenever you see this same scenario (yellow vs. red).  When that yellow gnome stops giving you a decent amount of mushrooms, switch to the other color.  When both color gnomes with small hats stop giving you a decent amount of mushrooms, switch to the big hat gnomes.  When you see two big hat gnomes on screen, choose a color and see if it gives you a good reward.  If, keep choosing that color every time you see those two same gnomes against each other.  So if I see a brown and a purple big hate gnome, and brown gives my 35 mushrooms, I'm going to keep choosing that same color gnome whenever those two gnomes show up on screen until the mushrooms go down in number. Now, you see big versus small, as well, so try sticking with your lucky colors (remember yellow small gnome, brown big hat gnome).  Whenever a color that you've had good luck with pops up on screen, keep choosing that color.  When that gnome stops giving you points, or it drops down to fewer than 10 points, try the other color.  So if yellow stops working for you, try the red gnome.  Overall, the trick to this game to is remember where you've had good luck, and to try the other colors/hat sizes once that luck starts to run out.
